android.desc:
Subscriptions and free trials can quickly add up – U.S. adults spend about $91 per month on average, and nearly half forget to cancel trials. 

Subscription Tracker & Manager is an all-in-one personal finance app and budgeting tool that keeps all your recurring payments organized. Track subscriptions, bills, and free trials in one place, and get notified days before any due date so you never miss a payment. 

All-in-One Tracking: Monitor and manage all your subscriptions, bills and recurring payments in one place. Organize your services and cancel unused subscriptions or free trials with ease to avoid unexpected charges.


Bill Calendar & Reminders: View upcoming due dates on a built-in calendar. Customize alerts to notify you 1–7 days before each charge so no bill or renewal slips by you.


Spending Analytics: Keep an eye on your finances with clear charts and budgets. Visualize monthly spending totals and trends across all subscriptions to help you save money.


Budgeting & Finance Manager: Use this app as a budgeting tool and personal finance manager. Track all expenses, set savings goals, and get actionable insights to improve your financial health.


Global Currency Support: Works worldwide with major currencies (USD, GBP, EUR, etc.). Ideal for users in the USA, UK, Canada, Australia and Europe.


Free Trial Alerts: Set reminders for trial periods so you can cancel before being charged. Studies show nearly 50% of people forget to cancel trials – you won’t with timely notifications.


Don’t wait – download Subscription Tracker & Manager now and never forget a payment again! Start for free and take control of your spending today.


Privacy Note: All your data stays private on your device. 

Download now to streamline your subscriptions and keep your budget on track

quotes.title: Cancel unwanted subscriptions by tracking all recurring payments in one place
